# 4 bedroom detached house for sale

> This superb four-bedroom detached residence enjoys a prime position on the ever-popular School Lane in North Hykeham, combining stylish presentation with practical living space ideally suited to family living. The property is approached via electric secure gated off-road parking, providing both convenience and peace of mind. Internally, the property benefits from wooden shutters throughout.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bedrooms
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: School Lane, Lincoln
- Cena: £350,000
